description: Find nearby food pantries for someone who needs food. Give a location — a US ZIP code, "City, ST", or "lat,lng" — and it returns the closest pantries with address, phone, website and distance, from a directory of ~17,000 US food pantries. Use it when someone asks where to get free food or find a food pantry. Free, no signup. Call the pantry to confirm hours and eligibility before visiting — this tool does not have live hours.

limit.description: How many pantries to return (default 5, max 15).

name: find_food_pantry
title: Find a food pantry near a location
